description: This file contains the implementation of PHP ctype functions through regex, providing character classification utilities like ctype_alnum, ctype_alpha, ctype_digits, etc., as part of the Symfony polyfill package.

classes.name: Ctype
classes.description: Final class providing static methods that implement ctype character classification functions using regex.

methods.name: ctype_alnum
methods.description: Checks if every character in input is a letter or digit.

methods.name: ctype_alpha
methods.description: Checks if every character in input is a letter.

methods.name: ctype_cntrl
methods.description: Checks if every character in input is a control character.

methods.name: ctype_digit
methods.description: Checks if every character in input is a decimal digit.

methods.name: ctype_graph
methods.description: Checks if every character in input is printable and visible (no white space).

methods.name: ctype_lower
methods.description: Checks if every character in input is a lowercase letter.

methods.name: ctype_print
methods.description: Checks if every character in input is printable, including space.

methods.name: ctype_punct
methods.description: Checks if every character in input is a punctuation character.

methods.name: ctype_space
methods.description: Checks if every character in input is whitespace.

methods.name: ctype_upper
methods.description: Checks if every character in input is an uppercase letter.

methods.name: ctype_xdigit
methods.description: Checks if every character in input is a hexadecimal digit.

methods.name: convert_int_to_char_for_ctype
methods.description: Converts integer values to their corresponding character representation for ctype checks, interpreting integer in specific ASCII range.
